content:
Apple released the second developer beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate yesterday, and today the company has begun rolling out the update to public beta testers. Details below.

macOS 27.2 Public Beta 1 is available for download starting today

Apple announced last week that it would skip the macOS 27.1 testing cycle and go straight to releasing the first developer beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate. The company followed up yesterday by releasing the second developer beta.

This adjustment appears to be related to the iPhone Duo, which will go on sale on October 23 and come pre-installed with iOS 27.1. iOS 27.1 is expected to focus primarily on features and changes designed for the new foldable device, which is also the reason Apple has jumped its other operating system beta versions directly to version 27.2.

As for the new features included in the current macOS 27.2 beta, the most notable is the expanded language support for Siri AI, which Apple previously promised to roll out in October. As of the second beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, Siri AI now supports French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish in addition to English.

macOS 27.2 Public Beta 1 has the build number 26B5091g, the same as the second developer beta.

To participate in Apple's free public beta program, visit beta.apple.com to sign up.
